g.text: Repeated forced high-rate choices can prevent learned decisions
Matched 90 s development case, 1.5 Mb/s. Decision calls are not distinct downloads.
Cold in-Load initialization; one session per policy. Startup treatment changes forced duration and initial rate.
Both policies still stall substantially; this is mechanism evidence, not final performance.
